quarterly_data.signal: Applied's Q3 FY2026 earnings release (quarter ended July 26, 2026) segment tables: in the year-ago quarter (Q3 FY2025) Semiconductor Systems revenue was $5,564 million and Applied Global Services revenue was $1,463 million; foundry, logic and other was 67% of Semiconductor Systems revenue in Q3 FY2026 (69% a year earlier). The release also says Applied expanded its manufacturing and R&D operations in Singapore with the new US$500 million Tampines Campus, which more than doubles its advanced cleanroom capacity in Singapore.
